note: Both sets extract highly redundant claims and make incorrect visual estimates from the plot (e.g., estimating pitch sensitivity at 0 degrees as -30E+6 watt/rad when the plot explicitly states it is -25.52E+6 watt/rad). Set B includes even more redundant claims and misbinds values to 'Blade-Pitch Controller' with truncated units. Set A is slightly better because it has fewer of these redundant and misbound claims.
